scope: 4 final HTML glossaries; 189 headings; 496 source-specific definitions
checks: Independent dt/dd count and full-text comparison
Every translation bound to English SHA-256
Conditions, qualifiers, negations, examples and list items compared with English
Acronyms excluded; longest bounded match; singular/plural handling
See directives distinguished from lexical matches; italics alone do not assert a reference
limitations: Independent human peer review has not been performed. Lexical matches are textual evidence, not semantic dependency judgments. Git history records subsequent corrections.
